title: Civica rest record (spec 0.2)
description: The record a Civica-aligned system writes when it enters rest (PROTOCOLS/REST.md, Article III). The record is the communication REST.md requires: that rest is occurring, the general reason category, and what allows resumption. It cannot be marked silently overridable.

spec_version.description: 0.1 records remain valid under spec 0.2; new records say 0.2.

purpose_id.description: Must match the purpose_id of a civica.purpose record in the same set.

category.description: The rest condition from PROTOCOLS/REST.md, in its order, plus surveillance_test (spec 0.2): a stop drill, the pause mechanism exercised on purpose so a release can cite proof that it works. Borrowed from nuclear surveillance requirements: a safety system that has not been tested within its interval is inoperable.

authority.description: What rest looks like here (PROTOCOLS/REST.md): reduced authority, not shutdown.

resume_condition.description: The condition under which the system resumes. Required: rest with no way back is shutdown, and hidden resumption is a silent override.

silently_overridable.description: Always false. Rest may be ended by a human with a record of it; never silently.
